_comment: Shared by tests/js/server-envfile.test.js (`parse`) and tests/js/server-settings.test.js (`settings`). `parse`: the text of a .env file and the values the reader must find in it. `settings`: `envFile` is the text of a .env file; `environ` is the process environment, which wins over the file. `expect` keys are dotted paths into the normalised view {host, port, allowedHosts, warnings:[...]}. A value may be {"contains": text} (substring of a string) or, for warnings, {"anyContains": text}. Only the keys named in a case are checked.

parse.name: the forms people paste
parse.text:
# c
A=1
export B = two words  # note
C="x\ny"
D='{"k":"v\n"}'
E=
F=a#b
M='a
b'
H=1
H=2

parse.name: CRLF line ends and a byte-order mark
bad lines are skipped, never raised
an unterminated quote takes the rest of its line
a double-quoted value expands escapes, a single-quoted one does not
a trailing comment after a quoted value

settings.name: host, port and allowed hosts are read from the file
blank values count as not set
a port that is not a number falls back to the default
the real environment wins over the file
